power_boundary: predictive statistical activity, not measured workload power

logic_energy_model.formula: E_logic_per_work = N_specialist_cycles_per_work * 4.9037945e-10 J at the 5.5ns statistical-power point

logic_memory_break_even.interpretation: under the statistical full-logic power model, logic energy equals the inherited HBM4 component-energy sensitivity at roughly 23.9M-35.5M cycles/work

HBM4_latency_capacity_integration.interpretation: under the inherited HBM4 model, dependent-latency/context capacity is tighter than peak bulk bandwidth before compute; neither is achieved DP6 throughput

replicated_compute_sensitivity.epistemic_boundary: linear replication ignores shared control/PHY savings and assumes the statistical full-engine power point; it is a sensitivity envelope, not an optimized miner design

commodity_reference_boundary.reason: commodity figures are measured whole-system references while specialist values above are component/model sensitivities with missing memory PHY/package/board and workload activity
